name: LiveChat
description: LiveChat is Text's customer-messaging product for website chat, agent workspaces, routing, archives, automation, customer engagement, and operational support workflows.
agentUseSummary: Enter one customer-owned LiveChat personal access token, then let selected agents use content-free chat operations or approved documented Agent Chat API v3.5 actions under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: LIVECHAT_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: LiveChat personal access token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a personal access token with the minimum chats--access:ro scope for bounded reads. Broader actions require corresponding provider scopes.

capabilities.label: Read chat operations
capabilities.description: List and inspect bounded chat/thread operational metadata without messages, events, customer or agent identities, emails, session fields, visits, properties, tags, or attachments.

capabilities.label: Agent Chat API
capabilities.description: Use documented Agent Chat API v3.5 actions allowed by the connected LiveChat personal access token.

approvalRequired.label: List chat metadata
approvalRequired.description: List one fixed first page of content-free LiveChat operational summaries.

approvalRequired.label: Read chat metadata
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact LiveChat through Relay's content-free operational projection.

approvalRequired.label: Use Agent Chat API
approvalRequired.description: Use a documented LiveChat Agent Chat API v3.5 action authorized by the connected personal access token; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Content-free chat reads and every broader Agent Chat action require approval; fixed origin/version, secret isolation, provider scopes, and bounds remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected PAT-authorized actions run without Relay per-action approval; fixed origin/version, secret isolation, bounds, audits, provider scopes, and LiveChat limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted PAT only to the fixed LiveChat Agent Chat API v3.5 origin.
Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted PAT only to the fixed LiveChat Agent Chat API v3.5 origin.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer LiveChat personal access token with the selected provider scopes is required for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer creates a minimally scoped PAT, enters it in Relay, and verifies bounded reads, Safe approval, Dangerous broader action behavior, token rotation/revocation, and disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Text's official authorization overview recommends personal access tokens for direct LiveChat API requests and distinguishes them from multi-user OAuth flows.
The official Agent Chat API v3.5 reference documents the fixed api.livechatinc.com action origin, Basic PAT authentication, list/get chat actions, chat scopes, page limits, and provider errors.
Text documents chats--access:ro as read access to chats available through the requester's groups, supporting Relay's minimum bounded-read scope guidance.
